_comment: Synthetic fixture for the COpt vocabulary type. Mirrors the layout juliac would emit for `struct COpt{T}; has_value::Int32; value::T; end` (JLWInterop, commit df908fa) instantiated at T=Float64, with one @ccallable function borrowing a COpt{Float64} argument and one returning one. COpt is a by-value carrier (no heap allocation), so no jlw_free* entrypoints appear in this fixture and no free call is expected in the façade wrapper. Field offsets (has_value@0, value@8, size 16) match juliac's actual ABI JSON for `COpt{Float64}` verbatim: `has_value` is Int32 (4 bytes, ends at offset 4) but `value` starts at offset 8 — 4 bytes of trailing padding to satisfy Float64's 8-byte alignment. The Python emitter must recognize the COpt shape (name + 2-field shape: `has_value` an Int32 primitive, `value` a primitive in `pytypes`) and emit from_optional/as_optional helpers plus a by-value-unwrap façade wrapper with no free call.
